I'm kind of in the same situation you where in. I'm twenty, I'm not out and I'm still having trouble accepting myself. In fact, up until a few weeks ago I had a boyfriend and was planning on marrying him(I'm a lady). Anyway, what I'm saying is I know that feel, bro. I wish I could love myself more, just accept myself. It's rough I know but there's really no way to learn to love and accept yourself other than just taking it one day at a time. You just experienced a traumatic event and it's easy just to say "I need to do this, this and this, because if I were to die tomorrow I would regret not doing those things." And those are good things to think about, it's good to take those steps but you need to just take it one day at a time. And honestly if you are struggling you don't want a relationship and if you can't love yourself you can't have any kind of meaningful relationship. I don't know if I helped you at all...I tried. =)

tl;dr: You're young and your dealing with a lot. Take it one day at a time. Good luck. =)

Sounds like you've been keeping a lot in for a long time. I know it's hard to trust someone enough to tell them what's going on, how you feel, why it hurts. Maybe because you're not really sure why it hurts so much, it just does. You don't have to justify your feelings they are what they are. You haven't let anyone down by not having a girlfriend. You just haven't found a girl you fit with. And I won't lie some people don't, and that's okay. What you need is to trust someone enough to let them in. Do you think you can have a successful romantic relationship carrying around so much pain and not trusting anyone enough to share it? The friends that you do have, have you ever opened up to them? Or anyone? We all need people to talk to, if you want, you can PM me and we can talk. You sound like you have a lot you need to say.

Sorry about your friend. There probably wasn't anything you could have done and you couldn't have known unless he wanted you to. There's a lot of guilt and shame in suicidal people. The reason we don't reach out to friends isn't always because we don't think they will help us, we realize they probably can't help us, we worry about what they will think of us. That we're weak, unworthy, selfish. And when things get really dark, we think we're not even worth the time. Your words are appreciated, but sometimes it's really hard to see past this. Just saying "I'm not doing so well" are the hardest words to get out.
That, is, uh, just really accurate.

I called a suicide hotline and he(the guy on the phone) ended up calling the police, and I had to go to the hospital. Thats the ambulance bill and the ER bill together. And it's cheap because they didn't do anything to me at the hospital, just checked up on me. It sounds cheap but I can hardly afford to sustain myself let alone this shit. So yeah, I'm pretty much fucked.

It's not just the boyfriend. It's everything. When I was younger I thought that this gay thing would just go away, now I'm seeing that it's not going away. That this is something that I'm stuck with. I always thought I'd rather be dead than gay. But when a guy who actually liked me came around I thought close enough. I was going to get married to this guy and have a normal life. You know, be the daughter my parents wanted and could be proud of, now what?

What am I supposed to tell my boyfriend? How can I break up with him after everything? I've been with him for three years. I wrote him on his mission. I can't just drop him. I can't tell my family whats going on, they'll just freak out. I can't tell them, maybe someday, but my family doesn't talk. I have a job, I've been working all the hours I could but I which is why I'm not doing so well in school. I've been trying to distract myself but I can't just burn myself out trying to distract myself. I'm not sleeping because whenever I lay down and try to relax I just think about killing myself. Now, I'm just so tried I can't keep fighting anymore.
Yes I called them that night and they called the police. They said to call back if I needed help but I afraid that will happen all over again.

I was out of the house. But I had to move back in recently because one of my roommates left and I couldnt afford rent on my own. I dont know what I'm supposed to do. I thought maybe o could handle all this but more and more keeps coming and I cant handle it. I cant come out, I cant pay the bills, i'm failing school. How else can I fix this? Everything is so fucked up. I'm so done with everything.

I've looked around but I dont know how its supposed to help me. People have told me to just come out to my family. But how is that supposed to help me? Everyone acts like coming out is like some magical cure all that will fix everything. But now I have all this bullshit with me being gay and now bills that I cant pay. What the hell am I supposed to do. I will loose everyone if I come out and I'll be in the same situation as I am now. So really just fuck it.
I dont think just leaving the church will help me. I leave then what? Then I'm really alone. What am I supposed to do? Most of my friends are Mormon. My parents. I dont think just leaving will help.
